synthesis.summary: Admin 'Login as Scout user' (force-login to Scout PWA) intermittently fails silently. PR #410 merged 2026-09-15 fixed duplicate-GET token revocation; ticket filed next day during demo suggests NEW regression or uncovered failure mode. Three Scout users failed consecutively after initial success in same session.
synthesis.user_impact: Staff cannot reliably impersonate drivers to view Scout PWA, blocking admin support workflows and driver issue investigation. Silent 403 (no UI feedback) makes it appear as system hang rather than auth failure.
synthesis.business_context: Force-login is gate-bypassing admin tool for staff to view driver Scout PWA as that driver, essential for support and debugging. Unreliable access undermines support team efficiency and driver satisfaction.

notes.pr_410_changes: PR #410 (merged 2026-09-15) introduced ScoutForceTokens with session-tracked token IDs, keeping 3 most recent per driver to prevent duplicate-GET revocation. Tokens now tracked in impersonator's session via Session::push(clarity_scout_force_token_ids), revoked on leave()/exitAdminMode()/re-impersonation.
notes.admin_impersonator_lifecycle: admin_impersonator session set only when: (1) impersonating via /auth/impersonate AND impersonator ID in hardcoded admin list (lines 43-54 ImpersonateController), OR (2) using __qa/login route (local only, lines 188-191 web.php). Force-login REQUIRES admin_impersonator (line 16 ClarityScoutForceLoginController) or 403.
notes.session_invalidation_risk: ImpersonateController::impersonate() calls session()->invalidate() (line 35) when auth()->check() is true (starting new impersonation while authenticated), which clears ALL session including admin_impersonator. It then re-sets impersonator (line 41) and admin_impersonator (lines 56-58) based on request payload. If concurrent or overlapping impersonation calls occur, admin_impersonator could be transiently missing.
notes.consecutive_force_login_flow: Expected flow: Admin logs in → uses Backyard to /auth/impersonate (sets admin_impersonator) → clicks 'Login as Scout user' multiple times. Each force-login: (1) checks admin_impersonator, (2) mints token for driver, (3) pushes token ID to session array, (4) prunes driver's old tokens, (5) returns view with embedded token. No session invalidation between consecutive force-logins unless admin calls impersonate() again.
notes.token_coexistence: ClarityScoutForceLoginControllerTest line 58-78: test_mints_a_force_token_without_evicting_the_drivers_live_token proves force tokens (clarity-scout-force ability) coexist with driver's live tokens (clarity-scout-token). Force-login does NOT kick real driver off. Prune keeps 3 most recent per driver.
notes.failure_modes: Silent 403: admin_impersonator missing when expected. Silent 401: token revoked/expired, client handleUnauthorized() bounces to /scout/login with sessionStorage reason (PR #410). 404: kit has no assigned_user. Service worker cache: PR #410 excluded force-login HTML from SW cache.
notes.related_tickets: Prior work: guard shift end() for force-login impersonators; block lazy shift auto-start for force-login; force-login token lifecycle. All pre-PR-410.
